verdict.rationale: Square's first-party materials say Tap to Pay on iPhone accepts contactless cards, Apple Pay and other digital wallets in person, which is the phone-as-terminal capability, and the Mobile Payments SDK has dedicated Tap to Pay on iPhone docs. Availability is limited to listed card-processing countries. Missing for 10: evidence of Tap to Pay on Android or other off-the-shelf phones beyond iPhone, explicit device and setup requirements confirming no reader purchase, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
